import sys

MOD = 998244353
INV2 = 499122177

def fast_pow(a, e):
    return pow(a, e, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])

    cnt = r - l + 1
    cells = n * m

    if (n & 1) and (m & 1):
        print(fast_pow(cnt, cells))
    else:
        p = fast_pow(cnt, cells - 1)
        if cnt % 2 == 0:
            res = p * (cnt // 2) % MOD
        else:
            res = (p * ((cnt + 1) // 2) % MOD + MOD - (p + MOD - 1) % MOD * INV2 % MOD) % MOD
        print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
